Great chat this morning — appreciate you walking us through the use case and the decision criteria (latency under 300ms p95, audit logging, and ability to require VPC deployment for PHI). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can line up procurement and onboarding: 

Summary (from our discovery)
- Primary use: real-time clinical insights in provider portal (inference, embeddings for search).
- Key decision criteria: latency, data residency (US-only), SOC 2 + DPA, commercial terms (PO process + net terms).
- Expected monthly token volume: ~12M tokens (pilot), scale to ~60M in 6 months.

Actions we need from Primex
1) Procurement contact: who owns vendor onboarding and invoice issuance? (name/email)
2) Billing details: legal entity name, billing address, tax ID (for PO).
3) Preferred PO/invoice cadence and net terms (Net-30/Net-45/etc).
4) Any vendor form / compliance questionnaire to accelerate onboarding (attach if available).

What I'm sending now (attached)
- redwood_dpa_v2.pdf (DPA draft)
- redwood_po_template.pdf (sample PO + invoicing fields)
- soc2_report_summary.pdf (summary & SOC 2 contact)

Proposed timeline
- Procurement contact confirmed by EOD Thu 11/26
- Redwood to provide final DPA redlines for legal by Mon 11/29
- PO issued / vendor form completed by Primex by Wed 12/2 -> kick off onboarding week of 12/7

If there are constraints (e.g., must go through an approved vendor list or require additional security docs), let us know and we will prioritize.

Next meeting: would you prefer a short sync with your procurement lead and our finance ops this week? I can include Laura on billing and Marissa on implementation.

Thanks —
